title: Django vs FastAPI: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Django vs FastAPI: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: FastAPI generally leads due to its async nature and lower overhead.
• Latency: FastAPI's Pydantic validation and Starlette foundation offer lower latency.
• Consistency: Django's ORM and mature ecosystem can provide more predictable consistency.
• Failure Modes: Both are robust, but FastAPI's simplicity can lead to fewer complex failure points.
• Operational Overhead: Django can be more resource-intensive; FastAPI is typically lighter.

Recommendation: For raw performance and modern async APIs, FastAPI is often preferred. For rapid development with a full-featured, batteries-included approach, Django remains a strong contender.
